heartbeat.title: No tests this month — focus shifted to restoring flows
heartbeat.body_html: With flows attributing nothing this month, no A/B tests concluded, and our attention moved to the underlying cause rather than optimisation on top of zero. The transferable point stands regardless of any single month: wins from our testing program are banked permanently while losses cost nothing, so the flow program compounds at any strike rate once it is live. Our immediate work is getting the sequences firing again so that testing can resume its usual cadence and build on a working base.

The transferable point is structural: our testing program only compounds once flows are live and sending, because that is where wins get banked permanently at no cost to losses. Getting the flow layer producing is the step that unlocks that compounding, and it is our focus going into next month.
